records.label: Native before-upload confirmation
records.rationale: PCA-020 now has native before-upload confirmation evidence. Cancel, Escape and close skip upload while preserving the saved image, clipboard and later pin. The confirmed destination is frozen, credentials stay unread until consent, and global cancellation or owner destruction prevents a late upload.

records.label: PCA-021 native capture-file deletion
records.rationale: Opt-in native deletion follows shared engine guards; write-ahead staging preserves racing replacements at discoverable private recovery paths. Recovery-bearing wire version 2 is preserved by older binaries.

records.label: Verification is not release acceptance
records.rationale:
The audit gate configures a Debug Ninja build, builds with eight jobs and runs all
126 registered CTest targets with six-way concurrency. Contract lint, backlog and
generated desktop progress freshness are separate required checks. A green local
suite proves candidate behavior exercised by those tests; it does not qualify
unavailable desktops, hardware, physical accessibility, security review or releases.
Six desktop packages publish shared vector files; nine still lack them. No shared
expected result, contract, waiver or approval record was changed for this audit.
The previous dated findings remain in Git history. Current counts are the ones above.
